name: REPTFILE.jcl
description:
This JCL job defines a Generation Data Group (GDG) named AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANREPT to manage multiple generations of transaction report files, allowing up to 10 generations to be retained at any given time.Key Functionalities:
Defines a new Generation Data Group (GDG) base entry named AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANREPT to organize and manage versioned transaction report files.
Sets a retention limit of 10 generations, meaning up to 10 historical versions of the transaction report file can be stored and tracked simultaneously.
Establishes the catalog structure required before any actual transaction report files can be created and stored under this GDG.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system catalog does not already contain a Generation Data Group entry named AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANREPT
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Transaction Report storage group initialization job is executed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: A Generation Data Group named AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANREPT is successfully registered in the system catalog, making it available for all future Card Demo Transaction Report generation processes

rules.Rule_Name: STEP05 - IDCAMS - Define Transaction Report Generation Data Group
rules.Rule_Description: Establishes a versioned storage group named AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANREPT in the system catalog, enabling the Card Demo application to store and manage multiple rolling versions of its Transaction Reports.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction Report Generation Data Group AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANREPT is registered in the system catalog with a maximum retention limit of 10 versions
Acceptance_Criteria.When: A new version of the Card Demo Transaction Report is produced and stored, causing the total number of retained versions to exceed 10
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The oldest version of the Transaction Report is automatically retired and removed from the catalog, ensuring that at no point more than 10 versions of the Transaction Report are retained simultaneously

rules.Rule_Name: STEP05 - IDCAMS - Transaction Report Version Retention Limit
rules.Rule_Description: Enforces a rolling retention policy that limits the number of simultaneously available Transaction Report versions to a maximum of 10, ensuring automatic retirement of the oldest version when the limit is exceeded.
